title: Command palette: open, search, move through results with the keyboard, invoke, dismiss and reopen
preconditions: private scratch config (driver_app: bench config, ui.animations.enabled false)
a fresh saved session: one workspace, one terminal tab

steps.note: a person's Cmd-Shift-P opens the palette on its Commands scope (commandPalette)

expect.noReceiptReason: typing into the palette's field runs no registry action; it changes the query

steps.note: the palette's panel is the key window (target.overlay palette), as when a person types in it: the shell window would give the keys to its terminal. The query is hashed (querySha256); topIds and selectedIndex are the results the baseline keeps

expect.noReceiptReason: the open palette's key map moves the selection (PaletteKeyMap), not the registry
the open palette's key map moves the selection (PaletteKeyMap), not the registry
Return runs the selected row through the palette, which attributes the run to the row's action, not to the key

steps.note: Return in the palette's panel runs its top row for `new terminal tab`, New Terminal Tab (newSurface), as the person's: one tab more
the keyboard returns to the content: the new terminal tab, selected
the palette opens again; the settled checkpoint records whether it kept the last query

expect.noReceiptReason: Escape closes the palette through its key map (PaletteKeyMap), not the registry

steps.note: Escape in the palette's panel closes it (app_reset.DISMISS_KEYS aims its Escape the same way)
dismissal returns the keyboard to the content it came from

invariants: search, selection, invocation, dismissal and focus return are deterministic: two runs give equal settled checkpoints (querySha256, topIds, selectedIndex)
the palette is open from open-palette to invoke and from reopen-palette to dismiss, and closed between
invoke runs exactly the selected row: one terminal tab more, no other change
after invoke and after dismiss the focus is back in the content and focus.paletteOpen is false
every key from search to dismiss goes to the palette's panel (target.overlay palette): none reaches the terminal, so the shell runs no typed text
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started and its tag's daemons (TagTeardown)
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: pointer moves and clicks on rows (no pointer op in case-v1)
the palette's other scopes (palette.open needs a focused run; the actions/palette cases)
